entries.text: The published results corpus adds TPC-DS OBT cohorts at SF 0.01 (DuckDB, DataFusion, Apache Doris and LakeSail) and SF 0.1 (DuckDB, DataFusion and Apache Doris). Every bundle ran all 93 statements without failures, and each cohort meets the three-platform ranking floor.
details: Apache Doris ran in a 4 GiB container with parallel_pipeline_task_num=1, so its timings reflect one pipeline task per query fragment; DuckDB ran with 8 threads and DataFusion with 10 partitions.
